newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products stable as buyers wary of rally.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products stable as buyers wary of rally.

text.p: NWE oil products were little changed on Monday with benchmark crude and product futures holding sharp gains from Friday and keeping prospective buyers for physical product on the sidelines, brokers said.
They said dollar strength was also continuing to hamper demand from the key German market with end-users getting cheaper product from local refiners.
Prompt lifting gas oil barges were offered around August IPE +50 cents with early August offered at Aug IPE +75 cents. Buyers for both periods were around screen flat at best.
Diesel barges were steady at Aug IPE +$4/5 fob Rotterdam.
Gasoline was unchanged to slightly softer with Eurograde valued at $202, off 50 cents and regular at $191 fob ARA.
High sulphur fuel oil barges talked $89/$91.50 for July liftings with early August liftings talked $90/$92 fob ARA.
